name: a fire vent on an inert pan, no floor slab (FDSI-1)
text:
&HEAD CHID='pan' /
&MESH IJK=10,10,10, XB=-2,2,-2,2,0,3 /
&SURF ID='FIRE', HRRPUA=500. /
&OBST XB=-0.5,0.5,-0.5,0.5,0,0.3 /
&VENT XB=-0.5,0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.3,0.3, SURF_ID='FIRE' /
&OBST XB=1.9,2.0,-2,2,0,2.5 /
&DEVC ID='t1', XYZ=1,0,1.5, QUANTITY='THERMOCOUPLE' /
&TAIL /

name: the standard FDS burner, SURF_IDS on a pan (FDSI-2)
text:
&HEAD CHID='ids' /
&MESH IJK=10,10,10, XB=-2,2,-2,2,0,3 /
&SURF ID='BURNER', HRRPUA=500. /
&OBST XB=-0.5,0.5,-0.5,0.5,0,0.3, SURF_IDS='BURNER','INERT','INERT' /
&DEVC ID='t1', XYZ=1,0,1.5, QUANTITY='THERMOCOUPLE' /
&TAIL /

name: a box burning on every face (FDSI-3)
text:
&HEAD CHID='box' /
&MESH IJK=10,10,10, XB=-2,2,-2,2,0,3 /
&SURF ID='FIRE', HRRPUA=100. /
&OBST XB=-0.5,0.5,-0.5,0.5,0,1, SURF_ID='FIRE' /
&TAIL /

name: MULT: sequential DXB with DX0 (FDSI-4a)
text:
&HEAD CHID='m1' /
&MESH IJK=10,10,10, XB=-2,10,-2,2,0,3 /
&SURF ID='FIRE', HRRPUA=500. /
&OBST XB=-0.25,0.25,-0.25,0.25,0,0.1, SURF_ID6='INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','FIRE' /
&MULT ID='row', DXB=1,1,0,0,0,0, DX0=5, N_LOWER=0, N_UPPER=2 /
&OBST ID='post', XB=0,0.5,1,1.5,0,1, MULT_ID='row' /
&TAIL /

name: MULT: DX with N_UPPER is four copies (FDSI-4b)
text:
&HEAD CHID='m2' /
&MESH IJK=10,10,10, XB=-2,10,-2,2,0,3 /
&SURF ID='FIRE', HRRPUA=500. /
&OBST XB=-0.25,0.25,-0.25,0.25,0,0.1, SURF_ID6='INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','FIRE' /
&MULT ID='row', DX=1, N_UPPER=3 /
&OBST XB=0,0.5,1,1.5,0,1, MULT_ID='row' /
&TAIL /

name: MULT: a one-sided skip removes the rest of the axis (FDSI-4c)
text:
&HEAD CHID='m3' /
&MESH IJK=10,10,10, XB=-2,10,-2,2,0,3 /
&SURF ID='FIRE', HRRPUA=500. /
&OBST XB=-0.25,0.25,-0.25,0.25,0,0.1, SURF_ID6='INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','FIRE' /
&MULT ID='row', DX=1, I_UPPER=5, I_LOWER_SKIP=3 /
&OBST XB=0,0.5,1,1.5,0,1, MULT_ID='row' /
&TAIL /

name: MLRPUA with no heat of combustion is still the fire (FDSI-5)
text:
&HEAD CHID='mlr' /
&MESH IJK=10,10,10, XB=-2,2,-2,2,0,3 /
&REAC FUEL='HEPTANE' /
&SURF ID='POOL', MLRPUA=0.05 /
&VENT XB=-0.5,0.5,-0.5,0.5,0,0, SURF_ID='POOL' /
&TAIL /

name: ids that used to collide (FDSI-6)
text:
&HEAD CHID='ids' /
&MESH IJK=10,10,10, XB=-2,4,-2,2,0,3 /
&SURF ID='FIRE', HRRPUA=500. /
&OBST XB=-0.25,0.25,-0.25,0.25,0,0.1, SURF_ID6='INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','FIRE' /
&OBST XB=1,1.5,1,1.5,0,1 /
&OBST ID='1', XB=2,2.5,1,1.5,0,1 /
&MULT ID='two', DX=0.6, I_UPPER=1 /
&OBST ID='Col', XB=1,1.5,-1.5,-1,0,1, MULT_ID='two' /
&OBST ID='Col 2', XB=3,3.5,-1.5,-1,0,1 /
&TAIL /

name: a rake keeps the file's own XY (FDSI-7)
text:
&HEAD CHID='rake' /
&MESH IJK=10,10,10, XB=-2,2,-2,2,0,3 /
&SURF ID='FIRE', HRRPUA=500. /
&OBST XB=-0.25,0.25,-0.25,0.25,0,0.1, SURF_ID6='INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','FIRE' /
&DEVC ID='TC1', XYZ=1.23456,0.98765,0.5, QUANTITY='THERMOCOUPLE' /
&DEVC ID='TC2', XYZ=1.23456,0.98765,1.0, QUANTITY='THERMOCOUPLE' /
&DEVC ID='TC3', XYZ=1.23456,0.98765,1.5, QUANTITY='THERMOCOUPLE' /
&TAIL /

name: FDS 6's current heat flux names are gauges (FDSI-14)
text:
&HEAD CHID='flux' /
&MESH IJK=10,10,10, XB=-2,2,-2,2,0,3 /
&SURF ID='FIRE', HRRPUA=500. /
&OBST XB=-0.25,0.25,-0.25,0.25,0,0.1, SURF_ID6='INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','INERT','FIRE' /
&DEVC ID='TOT', XYZ=1.5,0,1, IOR=-1, QUANTITY='TOTAL HEAT FLUX' /
&DEVC ID='GAS', XYZ=-1.5,0,1, ORIENTATION=1,0,0, QUANTITY='GAUGE HEAT FLUX GAS' /
&TAIL /
